blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill seeking to regulate deepfakes and other forms of AI-generated or manipulated media and hold perpetrators and digital platforms accountable was filed in the Senate on Monday.Sen. Mark Villar filed Senate Bill No. 2620, or the proposed “Kontra Malisyosong AI Act,” which seeks to address the misuse of a person’s face, voice, likeness and other personal attributes to create misleading or harmful content.In the bill’s explanatory note, Villar cited the Department of Information and Communications Technology’s (DICT) warning that cybercriminals use deepfakes for online scams, phishing, ransomware and other illicit activities.The note also identified the use […]...
